targets.queryText:
SELECT p.ts * 1000 AS time, p.value AS "PV production"
FROM point AS p
JOIN series AS s ON s.series_id = p.series_id
WHERE s.measurement = 'energy'
  AND s.field = 'pv_production'
  
  AND p.ts >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND p.ts <= $__unixEpochTo()
ORDER BY p.ts

targets.queryText:
SELECT p.ts * 1000 AS time, p.value AS "State of charge"
FROM point AS p
JOIN series AS s ON s.series_id = p.series_id
WHERE s.measurement = 'battery'
  AND s.field = 'state_of_charge'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_tag t WHERE t.series_id = s.series_id AND t.tag_key = 'agg_type' AND t.tag_value = 'mean')
  AND p.ts >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND p.ts <= $__unixEpochTo()
ORDER BY p.ts
